title: Love the app, but no widget
body: I love the general way this app works and it has a great layout. But I bought a premium subscription and I can’t seem to make the widget work 😟 I tried restarting my phone, but no widget option appears
author: Rlvk94

title: I’ve already paid, not you want a subscription?
body: This is ludicrous. I paid for the extra functionality in the app when I downloaded it last fall, and now all these functions are gone, and you want me to subscribe and pay a yearly fee? If I new this change was going to happen, I wouldn’t have paid a dime four months ago, and found another app instead.
author: Chris Alban
